configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.displayName: Native (SDL2, all renderers) -- the WASM twin / compat oracle, one binary
configurePresets.description: 32-bit native Linux build (needs libsdl2-dev:i386). BUILD_STATIC links every package into ONE Game binary -- no Core.so/Engine.so beside it; appGetDllHandle resolves through the internal UNREAL_STATIC registry (the template's ufront 2.34 arrangement). Renderers: XOpenGLDrv + OpenGLDrv/UTGLR (system GL) + SoftDrv + NullDrv. The renderer forks are fetched by branch (XOpenGLDrv hp2-v433-compat, utglr-copy hp2, gl4es fix/cubemap-bind-active-unit); point FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_XOPENGLDRV / _UTGLR / GL4ES_SOURCE_DIR at a local clone to build an unpushed change. Builds in build-native/.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O2 + DWARF + assertions. The everyday dev build -- named stacks and readable errors while the engine still runs at a playable speed. Builds in build-wasm/. Run `source ~/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh` first (sets EMSDK).

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O0, nothing inlined, every local live. Reach for it when the OPTIMISER is the suspect -- a bug that shows at one -O level and not another is almost always undefined behaviour. Builds in build-wasm-debug/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-perf
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build (-O3, no debug -> smaller/faster). Builds in build-wasm-perf/. What the ufrontend clone consumes.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: 32-bit Windows build, cross-compiled from Linux via the toolchain file (i686-w64-mingw32 + a fetched SDL2); the SAME preset works from an MSYS2 MINGW32 prompt. BUILD_STATIC links every package into the exe -- no Core.dll/Engine.dll. Renderers: UTGLR (OpenGLDrv) + XOpenGLDrv through the system opengl32, plus SoftDrv + NullDrv (CPU-only, verifiable headless under wine+Xvfb). Audio: NOpenALDrv with OpenAL Soft's OpenAL32.dll copied beside the exe. Builds in build-windows/.
